entries.zh: 三；数目字三（条内兼注口语音、读书音两读）
三个；三件，带量词形式的三
entries.notes: 字义四栏互证明确（Tres/三个/sã-çe），唯声调号污损难辨（T99），按封存标记降为低置信

entries.zh: 申（十二时辰之一），约当午后三至五时；西注『午后三点与四点』
entries.en: the shen double-hour (roughly 3-5 p.m.); Spanish gloss 'three and four of the afternoon'
entries.notes: 汉字栏残损但『申』可辨，与音写 sin-si（申时）及西注午后时刻互证；因[残]标记按例降级

entries.zh: 及第；科举考试登第、中式（西注大意：科第中居先之名次）
entries.en: to pass the imperial examination; to attain (high) examination rank or degree

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
卅；三十
三十
三旬；三十日（三旬约当一月之期）。字形或作『句』，据对音当为『旬』（旬=十日）；西注大意：三十，用以计月、日、年
entries.en: three ten-day decades, i.e., thirty days; character uncertain between 句 and 旬, the reading supports 旬
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:句/旬]且声调号污损（T99）；对音 sam-çun 支持『旬』，西文缩写展开亦依赖推断

entries.en: Board (Ministry) of Personnel; tribunal where mandarins are appointed and ranked

户部；六部之一，掌财赋、户籍、税课
entries.en: Board of Revenue (Ministry of Finance and Household Registration)
entries.notes: 字义四栏互证明确（户部/tribunal de hacienda），唯声调号污损难辨（T99），按封存标记降为低置信

entries.zh: 刑部；六部之一，掌刑狱司法
工部；六部之一，掌营造、工程、修缮（西注：掌修缮营造之衙门）
entries.en: Board of Works (Public Works); tribunal of works and repairs

entries.en: Board of Rites; tribunal of ceremony and nurture (criança)

entries.en: official hall; tribunal or yamen building

entries.en: judgment hall, court where cases are tried
